channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Spencer Hawes | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Spencer Hawes from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: John Hammond on Spencer Hawes
item.description:
In a related transaction,the Bucks have requested waivers on forward Steve Novak.

“Spencer and Roy are two proven NBA centers who give us additional depth and versatility in the front court,”

John Hammond on Spencer Hawes, Feb 2, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Avery Bradley on Jamal Crawford, Spencer Hawes
item.description:
But a couple of his friends on the Clippers from Seattle may try to be in Glendale, Ariz.

“Me, Spencer (Hawes) and Jamal (Crawford) were talking before the game Monday, and they were saying that if they have enough free time, they might even go to the game,”

Avery Bradley on Jamal Crawford, Spencer Hawes, Jan 23, 2015. Source: Boston Herald.

item.title: Brett Brown on Spencer Hawes
item.description:
#Sixers coach Brett Brown on Spencer Hawes' impact on team:

“Once Spencer’s news becomes more clear, then I can speak more clearer about it”

Brett Brown on Spencer Hawes, Feb 20, 2014. Source: Twitter @ChrisVito.

item.title: Thaddeus Young on Spencer Hawes
item.description:
“Spencer’s been playing great. When he’s playing with that type of energy, that type of intensity, he makes it better for all of the guys on the team.”

Thaddeus Young on Spencer Hawes, Mar 29, 2013. Source: phillyburbs.com.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Spencer Hawes
item.description:
KC Johnson:Thibs on Hawes foul:

“I have to get more clarity on what a flagrant foul is because I don’t understand that.”

Tom Thibodeau on Spencer Hawes, May 11, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Shawn Kemp on Spencer Hawes
item.description:
“Me and Spencer down in the post, beating each other up. A lot of elbows being thrown. A lot of real physical play.”

Shawn Kemp on Spencer Hawes, Jan 10, 2012. Source: CSNPhilly.com.

item.title: Andre Iguodala on Jason Kapono, Spencer Hawes
item.description:
“I have a couple of teammates, Jason Kapono and Spencer Hawes, who are into it. I always read USA Today and the Wall Street Journal, and I have an E-Trade account, so the interest in finance has always been there.“Also, being an athlete I’ve been blessed with an opportunity to make a good living and be able to hold on to a good amount of wealth. I understand that this basketball thing is a small window. The things that I’m getting from basketball … I want to stretch it out my whole life.”

Andre Iguodala on Jason Kapono, Spencer Hawes, Sep 29, 2011. Source: Yahoo! Sports.
